conceptual assets.concept: Module enable control (ctrl.enable) that gates operation, FIFO clear and interrupt outputs
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access writes the enable bit: "ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c);" (on bus write to addr(3 downto 2) = "00"). The enable value is used to force FIFO clear: "rx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.rx_clr;" and "tx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.tx_clr;" and to gate interrupts: "rx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (... )" and "tx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (... )". The RTL therefore implements behaviors (FIFO clear and interrupt gating) that depend on ctrl.enable; corruption or incorrect setting of this stored bit changes those behaviors.

conceptual assets.concept: RX interrupt configuration bits controlling when rx_irq_o asserts (irq_rx_nempty, irq_rx_half, irq_rx_full)
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access writes the RX IRQ configuration bits from bus data on writes to addr group "00": e.g. "ctrl.irq_rx_nempty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_nempty_c);". The rx_interrupt process computes the interrupt: "rx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_nempty and (    rx_fifo.avail)) or (ctrl.irq_rx_half and (    rx_fifo.half)) or (ctrl.irq_rx_full and (not rx_fifo.free)));". These stored bits directly determine the interrupt condition; modifying them changes interrupt behavior.

conceptual assets.concept: TX interrupt configuration bits controlling when tx_irq_o asserts (irq_tx_empty, irq_tx_nhalf, irq_tx_nfull)
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access writes the TX IRQ configuration bits from bus data on writes to addr group "00": e.g. "ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c);". The tx_interrupt process computes: "tx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_tx_empty and (not tx_fifo.avail)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf and (not tx_fifo.half)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_nfull and ( tx_fifo.free)));". These stored bits directly control tx_irq_o assertions; corruption alters interrupt signaling.

conceptual assets.concept: RX FIFO clear control bit (ctrl.rx_clr) that triggers clearing RX FIFO/attributes
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access writes ctrl.rx_clr from bus data on writes to addr group "00": "ctrl.rx_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_rx_clr_c);". The clear feeds the FIFO clear input: "rx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.rx_clr;" and rx_attributes reacts to clears: on rx_fifo.clear = '1' the code sets "rx_last <= '0'". Therefore the stored ctrl.rx_clr directly controls FIFO clear and attribute reset; incorrect setting changes stored-frame availability and attributes.

conceptual assets.concept: TX FIFO clear control bit (ctrl.tx_clr) that triggers clearing TX FIFO
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access writes ctrl.tx_clr from bus data on writes to addr group "00": "ctrl.tx_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_tx_clr_c);". The clear feeds the FIFO clear input: "tx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.tx_clr;". The stored ctrl.tx_clr therefore directly controls clearing of queued transmit frames; corruption changes queued-data retention.

conceptual assets.concept: Route destination register (route_dst) used to tag enqueued TX frames
conceptual assets.reasoning: bus_access stores the destination: "if (bus_req_i.addr(3 downto 2) = \"01\") then route_dst <= bus_req_i.data(3 downto 0); end if;". tx_fifo.wdata is built from route_dst: "tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.addr(2) & route_dst & bus_req_i.data;". Thus route_dst is embedded into enqueued TX words; corrupting it changes the destination tag placed on outgoing frames.

conceptual assets.concept: Received-frame attributes (last-dequeued frame source ID and last flag: route_src, rx_last)
conceptual assets.reasoning: rx_attributes captures attributes when a FIFO read occurs: "if (rx_fifo.re = '1') then route_src <= rx_fifo.rdata(35 downto 32);" and "elsif (rx_fifo.re = '1') then rx_last <= rx_fifo.rdata(36);". bus_access returns route_src and rx_last in reads (route_src in addr group "01" and rx_last via ctrl_rx_last_c in group "00"). These stored attributes represent the last dequeued frame's source and last flag; corruption or incorrect storage misreports frame attributes.

conceptual assets.concept: RX FIFO contents and occupancy flags (received frames, rx_fifo.rdata and rx_fifo.avail/free/half)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module connects an instantiated FIFO and drives/reads its interface: rx_fifo.we <= slink_rx_valid_i; rx_fifo.wdata(31 downto 0) <= slink_rx_data_i; rx_fifo.wdata(35 downto 32) <= slink_rx_src_i; rx_fifo.wdata(36) <= slink_rx_last_i; rx_fifo.re is asserted on bus reads: "rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(3) = '1')"; bus_access returns rx_fifo.rdata for reads and uses rx_fifo.avail/half/free in status fields; rx_interrupt also uses rx_fifo.avail/half/free to drive rx_irq_o. The FIFO rdata and occupancy flags are therefore the stored/observable RX-frame state that flows to reads and interrupts.

conceptual assets.concept: TX FIFO contents and occupancy flags (enqueued frames, tx_fifo.rdata and tx_fifo.avail/free/half)
conceptual assets.reasoning: tx_fifo is written from bus writes and read by the link: "tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(3) = '1')" and "tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.addr(2) & route_dst & bus_req_i.data;". tx_fifo.re <= slink_tx_ready_i; outputs are driven from tx_fifo.rdata and tx_fifo.avail (see slink_tx_* assignments) and tx_interrupt uses tx_fifo.avail/half/free. The FIFO rdata and occupancy flags therefore realize the enqueued-TX-frame state that the module presents and uses.

conceptual assets.concept: Outgoing slink transmit outputs (slink_tx_data_o, slink_tx_dst_o, slink_tx_last_o, slink_tx_valid_o) presenting TX frames to the link
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module drives transmit outputs directly from the FIFO outputs: "slink_tx_data_o <= tx_fifo.rdata(31 downto 0);" "slink_tx_dst_o <= tx_fifo.rdata(35 downto 32);" "slink_tx_last_o <= tx_fifo.rdata(36);" "slink_tx_valid_o <= tx_fifo.avail;". These exit ports are the module's actual presentation of TX frames/validity to downstream logic; incorrect values violate the final transmitted frame semantics.

conceptual assets.concept: Incoming slink ready output (slink_rx_ready_o) that advertises RX acceptance
conceptual assets.reasoning: slink_rx_ready_o is driven from FIFO free: "slink_rx_ready_o <= rx_fifo.free;". The ready signal is the module's communicated capacity to accept incoming frames; incorrect presentation of this exit port misleads a peer about acceptance and changes the receive flow.

conceptual assets.concept: RX interrupt output signal (rx_irq_o) sent to CPU
conceptual assets.reasoning: rx_interrupt computes the output: "rx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_nempty and (    rx_fifo.avail)) or (ctrl.irq_rx_half and (    rx_fifo.half)) or (ctrl.irq_rx_full and (not rx_fifo.free)));". rx_irq_o is an exit port that signals RX conditions to software; corruption or incorrect assertion/failure to assert violates the implemented interrupt semantics.

conceptual assets.concept: TX interrupt output signal (tx_irq_o) sent to CPU
conceptual assets.reasoning: tx_interrupt computes the output: "tx_irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_tx_empty and (not tx_fifo.avail)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf and (not tx_fifo.half)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_nfull and (    tx_fifo.free)));". tx_irq_o is an exit port that signals TX conditions to software; corruption or incorrect assertion/failure to assert violates the implemented interrupt semantics.
